headline: F1 A wage-earning wife is taxed separately with two parts: two-earner married couples pay far less than unmarried ones

scale.source: CGI tome I art. 95 I: start of the 45 % band 'entre 2.500.001 et 8.000.000 de francs' (finances.gouv.cg)
scale.basis: CGI tome I art. 95 I: start of the 45 % band 'entre 2.500.001 et 8.000.000 de francs' (finances.gouv.cg). A statutory band threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'progressive, family quotient' confirmed with a twist: the chef de famille's joint return, but a married woman with wage income only is assessed separately as 'mariée sans enfants' (2 parts) (art. 4 1°); parts up to 6.5 (art. 91); tariff per part 1/15/30/45/50 % (art. 95), nothing collected below 265 000; 20 % deduction (art. 41); CNSS 4.55 % + CAMU 2.27 % employee (LF 2025 art. 9).
